items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Lester took more solos than Herschel in Basie's band.

ctx.x: But he converted alto players into tenor players because he loved tenor because of Herschel. He loved Herschel. And Hamp was a soul man himself, but he said Herschel had more soul than anybody I know. And he did.
Yeah, of course, (inaudible) we don't have that much by Herschel because, you know, Lester took more solos than Herschel in Basie's band.
It's sentimental for you, though, isn't it?
